_Regenerated 2026-11-16 for the modular engine (was: vendored qrcodegen file)._

## Inventory

### Core library (`molqrc`)

Public surface (re-exported from `lib.rs`): `QrCode`, `QrSegment`, `QrSegmentMode`,
`QrCodeEcc`, `Version`, `Mask`, `BitBuffer`, `DataTooLong`.

| src/ | owns |
|------|------|
| `segment.rs` | `QrSegment`, `QrSegmentMode`: factories, mode detection, count-field widths, total bit length |
| `bits.rs` | `BitBuffer` |
| `ecc.rs`, `version.rs`, `error.rs` | `QrCodeEcc`, `Version`, `Mask` (incl. mask formulas), `DataTooLong` |
| `capacity.rs` | ECC tables, raw/data codeword counts, alignment positions, `BlockLayout` |
| `reed_solomon.rs` | GF(256) arithmetic, generator/remainder, block interleaving |
| `canvas.rs` | module grid under construction: function patterns, format/version bits, zigzag placement, masking |
| `penalty.rs` | mask penalty score (N1–N4, Nayuki's finder-like detection) |
| `qrcode.rs` | `QrCode`: version search, ECC boost, data codewords, mask choice |
| `tests.rs` | known-answer tests of the internals |

Tests outside the crate: `tests/conformance.rs` (differential against
`qrcodegen` @ `bcfe1b0`), `tests/panics.rs` (panic parity).

### WASM bindings (`molqrc-wasm`)

| wasm/src/ | public surface | layer | notes |
|-----------|----------------|-------|-------|
| `lib.rs` | pure: `render_matrix`, `render_svg`, `render_ascii`, `render_encode` — bindgen: `qr_encode`/`QrResult`, `qr_modules`, `qr_side`, `qr_svg`, `qr_ascii` | adapter | All logic lives in the pure `render_*` fns (natively unit-tested); the `#[wasm_bindgen]` wrappers are thin. Ships to npm as `@molcrafts/molqrc-wasm`. |

### Web demo

| molqrc_web/ | role |
|-------------|------|
| `index.html` | Interactive QR designer — themes, module styles, colours, advanced ECL/version/mask panel, PNG + SVG download. Consumes only `qr_encode`; renders the grid itself. |
| `pkg/` | Committed `--target web` wasm build so the page is servable as static files. |

### Tooling

| scripts/ | role |
|----------|------|
| `verify-wasm-parity.sh`, `wasm-parity.mjs` | Diffs compiled wasm output against native output, module for module. |
| `examples/dump_reference.rs` | Emits native encoder output as JSON for the parity check. |

### Layer diagram

```
Nayuki qrcodegen @ bcfe1b0 (dev-dependency) ──► tests/conformance.rs, tests/panics.rs
                                                        │ module-for-module equality
segment ─► qrcode ─► reed_solomon ─► canvas ◄─ penalty  ▼
  bits      │ capacity (tables)                     src/ engine
            ▼
wasm/src/lib.rs   render_* (pure)  ──►  #[wasm_bindgen] surface
     ├──► --target bundler ──► npm @molcrafts/molqrc-wasm
     └──► --target web     ──► molqrc_web/pkg  ──► index.html
```

### Invariants

- Output equals Nayuki's `qrcodegen` for every input, errors and panics
  included; `tests/conformance.rs` is the correctness argument.
- Matrix format: `0` = light, `1` = dark, row-major, length `side * side`.
- QR Version 1–40, all 4 ECL levels (L/M/Q/H).
- The crate has zero runtime dependencies; `molqrc-wasm` depends only on
  `wasm-bindgen`.
